_note: Golden answers for the pilot conversations, checked by hand against the recordings on 14 Nov 2026 (see docs/DASHBOARD_CONTRACT.md). tools/audit-pilot.mjs compares the exported CSV with these, so a change to a reading rule that alters any of them is caught before it reaches the dealer. Only fields our own rules decide are pinned here. Scores, outcomes and AI text are the backend's and are not pinned. To change an answer on purpose, edit it here and say why in the commit.

confirmed_names._note: Names that are also spoken in the audio, confirmed by the floor so the audit does not warn. 266: the rep's app showed Hardikkumar Joshi as sales consultant on 14 Nov, 5:40 pm; 'Hardik Joshi' at 23:18 is the rep giving his own name and 'Hardik bhai' at 15:11 is customers addressing the rep.

prices_checked_by_hand._note: Prices said in Hindi or Gujarati number words, where the audit cannot find digits. Each was read against the recording by hand on 14 Nov 2026: 261 0:49 'seventeen-fifty on road'; 262 4:13 '4 to 5 thousand more'; 264 2:50 'tees hazar' (30,000), 1:15 'gyarah sau' (1,100), 4:14 'das hazar paanch sau' (10,500), 10:25 'paanch sau' (500) and 'paintees sau' (3,500). 272 4:04 'around 20,000' and 4:11 '40-42,000' read by hand. 275: all four prices are digits on the line. 276 0:12 'aa 28 lakh ne 3 hajar' = 28,03,000; 0:54 '21 lakh ne 22,000, 22 lakh 17,000' = 22,17,000 (the rep corrects himself); 278 1:06 '28 lakh ne 90 hajar jevu' = about 28,90,000. 274: figures said in digits and Gujarati number words (for example '30 lakh ne 50 hajar', '1 lakh 50 hajar') were read against the recording.

266._why: EV enquiry. The 10 lakh said at 10:00 is a battery replacement cost, not a car price; the petrol, diesel and CNG talk is the rep listing other versions; rough price ranges are not a quotation; a name said in the audio is not published as the customer.

272._why: Repeat visit to settle price and delivery of a red 3XO. Quotations were sent on WhatsApp, so no car price is said aloud; the value is the model's indicative band. 'Petrol diesel' at 0:04 is a stray opening word, not the customer's choice.

275._why: EV vs CNG enquiry for a 3XO. The EV was not at the showroom. Test drive: floor says it happened (note), the AI summary says none. Three models compared, so the value is the 3XO EV's typical price (indicative, marked ~), not a quote; the rep said about 15.5 lakh for the AX5.

276._why: Short walk-around of an older and the new model; no need, budget or follow-up. The model is never named, so there is no value. The wireless charger is not an EV-charging priority. Staff talk at the end is not part of the conversation.

278._why: Family at the Scorpio N top model; the car did not start; seat space concern; Innova and Fortuner mentioned. The 28.9 lakh is said in Gujarati number words with no basis, so the value is set in the notes as 'said in the call'. A test drive was talked about, not done.

274._why: Top 9e in Ruby Velvet, price negotiation (2 lakh scheme, 30.50 target), colour not in stock, customer may go to Ahmedabad. The rep says his own name (Joshi) at 24:08. On-road 31.89 lakh was the figure given as final. The AI's 30 lakh value came from the customer's own words, so the value is set in the notes.
